newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Dealers eye cold forecasts.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Dealers eye cold forecasts.

text.p: Grain dealers in the U.S. High Plains said they were closely monitoring forecasts for unseasonably cold temperatures Monday night and Tuesday morning in Nebraska and northern Kansas.

A daily weather forecasting map published by Weather Express showed temperatures Tuesday morning dropping into the 30s Farenheit across most of Nebraska. But some merchandisers said the wheat in those areas was not developed enough and would not likely be injured by the cold.
"Quite frankly, I don't think this will make a bit of difference, but we have to keep an eye on it," a dealer said.
Meanwhile, basis bids were steady to slightly higher, and movement remained slow.
"It's very quiet and there's not much left to buy. We're kind of in a holding pattern until harvest," a north central Oklahoma dealer said.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
